macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks partially recover after tech selloff
items.summary: The Nasdaq Composite rose about 1% and semiconductor stocks gained roughly 4% on Friday, while the S&P 500 advanced 0.3%, following Thursday’s sharp technology-led decline.[2]

items.title: Strong U.S. jobs report boosts December Fed hike expectations
items.summary: U.S. payrolls increased by 165,000 in October, exceeding forecasts, while unemployment fell to 4.1%. Markets priced in nearly an 80% probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike at its December meeting.[2][4]

items.title: AI and semiconductor stocks remain under pressure
items.summary: Investors continued to reassess the AI trade after election-related concerns about data-center regulation and development restrictions triggered a major selloff. The Nasdaq ended the week down 3.4%, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index suffered its steepest one-day decline in more than six years on Thursday.[1][4]

items.title: U.S. inflation reports become the next major market catalyst
items.summary: Investors are awaiting October consumer-price data on Tuesday and producer-price data on Friday. Economists expect headline CPI to rise 0.3% month over month and core CPI to increase 0.2%.[1]

items.title: Canadian labor market weakens
items.summary: Canada’s unemployment rate rose to 6.7% in October as employment fell for a third consecutive month, reducing market expectations for a December Bank of Canada rate hike to about 33%.[2]

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway reports mixed third-quarter results
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway’s third-quarter operating earnings fell 6% to $12.7 billion, roughly matching estimates, while revenue rose 11% to $105.6 billion, above forecasts.[6]

items.title: Major technology earnings scheduled for the coming week
items.summary: CoreWeave, Applied Materials and Cisco Systems are among the technology companies due to report earnings as investors focus on whether corporate results can offset concerns about stretched AI valuations.[4]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: U.S. Treasury Cuts MEXC Global Off from Financial System
items.summary: FinCEN reportedly barred U.S. financial institutions from transferring funds with MEXC Global, citing alleged links to sanctions evasion and cybercrime transactions. The action would significantly restrict the exchange’s access to the U.S. financial system.

items.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $75,900 as Ethereum Edges Higher
items.summary: Bitcoin was trading around $75,868 with essentially no 24-hour change, while Ethereum gained about 0.1% to approximately $2,240.24. Intraday ranges were relatively narrow compared with the week’s broader volatility.

items.title: GOPAX Suspends Trading and Withdrawals After Hacking Threat
items.summary: South Korean exchange GOPAX halted trading, deposits and standard withdrawals while moving assets to cold storage after a reported hacking threat. Manual withdrawals remained available through customer support.

items.title: Circle Mints $250 Million USDC on Solana
items.summary: Circle’s USDC Treasury reportedly minted 250 million USDC on the Solana network. The issuance adds to liquidity available for trading and decentralized-finance activity on Solana.

items.title: Fidelity Transfers About 27,000 ETH to Galaxy Digital
items.summary: On-chain monitoring reportedly identified a transfer of approximately 27,000 ETH from Fidelity to Galaxy Digital, valued at roughly $60 million at the cited price. The purpose of the transfer was not specified.

items.title: Schroders Brings Emerging-Market Bond Fund to Solana
items.summary: Asset manager Schroders reportedly plans to tokenize an emerging-market bond fund on Solana. SOL was cited at about $96.71, down 3.31% over 24 hours.

items.title: Hong Kong Plans Cryptocurrency Bill Before Year-End
items.summary: Hong Kong reportedly plans to submit legislation covering licensing for cryptocurrency transactions, custody, advisory services and administration before the end of the year.

items.title: Russia Identifies BTC, ETH and USDT for Potential Retail Trading
items.summary: Russia’s central bank reportedly named Bitcoin, Ether and USDT among assets that could be made available for controlled retail trading. Proposed safeguards include investor risk testing and annual purchase limits.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Stronghold 4 delayed; Company of Heroes 3 receives major update
items.summary: Stronghold 4 was delayed, while Company of Heroes 3 launched what was described as its biggest update to date. Steel Wolverines: Modern Armored Combat is also heading to Early Access, and Ashes of the Singularity II is scheduled for release next week.

items.title: GTA 6 end-credit length rumor circulates
items.summary: A report attributed to an unofficial source claims Grand Theft Auto VI may have more than 80 minutes of end credits, allegedly reflecting the large number of people involved in development. The claim remains unverified and should be treated as a rumor.

items.title: Virtual NHL, NBA and esports titles launched through bet365
items.summary: Inspired Entertainment announced the availability of V-Play NHL, NBA Re-Play and Re-Play eSports through bet365, expanding its virtual-sports lineup into hockey, basketball and esports-themed offerings.
